verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs mention security scanners (SAST/SCA/Secret Detection/DAST) surfacing findings directly in merge requests and agents reviewing code 'while your team stays in control,' implying some gating capability, but there is no direct evidence of configurable merge request approval rules, required approvals, protected branch policies, or customizable status checks that a devops-lead would set up to enforce merge standards. Missing for 10: documentation of approval rules/required reviewers, protected branch enforcement, customizable merge checks configuration, and independent confirmation these checks actually block merges.
